parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border/document restriction or police targeting is documented; X markers, non-medical LGR (resident-facing climate signal), and goods-and-services anti-discrimination protection in all states since 2017 are in force. Hate crimes are an aggravating factor and police arrested 15 people in the March 2025 neo-Nazi dating-app ambush network, showing recourse operating. That network, the far-right's 29.2% election win, a rejected queer-sauna petition and restrictive education rules show real hostility and political risk, but trans-specific victimisation in the ambushes and overall hate-crime figures is unresolved, and detained-trans housing rules are undocumented - an open question, not a documented exposure. Protection is documented more on paper than in trans-specific visitor outcomes, placing this in reduced rather than low risk.
